concurrency_ladder_text_plus_image.note: Ladder order was gate -> golden corpus -> prefill -> TTFT -> text ladder -> image ladder. The server crashed during the text ladder (C4) before the image ladder started. The single-request text+image throughput figure from the prior boot report (~55 tok/s per request, C1, from a separate session) is carried forward as measured-but-not-reproduced-in-this-run; it is not re-measured here.
